# xv6-riscv (MIT 6.S081, Fall 2019, lab edition): study copy

`third_party/xv6-riscv-fall19/` holds the C, assembly, Makefile and lab-grading files of xv6 for RISC-V, as the user attached them
on 2026-10-27 (`xv6-riscv-fall19.zip`). The PDFs in its `doc/` folder are not copied: the RISC-V privileged and calling-convention
specifications, the FU540 manual and the virtio specification are already project documents.

xv6 is Copyright (c) 2006-2019 Frans Kaashoek, Robert Morris, Russ Cox, MIT, under the MIT licence (see `xv6-riscv-fall19/LICENSE`).
It is a re-implementation of Dennis Ritchie's and Ken Thompson's Unix Version 6.

Nothing here is built or shipped. It is read as a reference. Saem code derived from an xv6 mechanism says so in its first
line, for example `// Adapted from xv6-riscv (MIT): kernel/bio.c. Rewritten in C17 for the Saem sovereign kernel.`
The knowledge note is `docs/knowledge/xv6.md`.
